comparison.objective: Carry a loaded hotel pan level, lower it into a close-fitting well, and release it; the candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual heavy-load stabilization, spill-limited transport, and tight-fit lowering versus precision rotary adjustment and counter-torque locking.
comparison.success_condition: Requires level, spill-free seating of the released pan; candidate requires a locked angular setting, retained nuts, three cycles, and clear tools.
comparison.reason: The record tests coordinated load transport and seating, with no relevant adjustable fastener or retention verification.
